_comment: Understood table layouts, emitted field by field by tools/disasm_all.py. Each table: bank, addr (hex CPU address), label (an alias; Data_BBB_AAAA labels are kept), count, id_base (optional; record index + id_base is shown in comments), fields (db N bytes | ptr = 16-bit pointer into the same bank), and note. Every layout cites its evidence in docs/EVIDENCE_LOG.md. Field names state only what the evidence supports.

tables.label: SoundBankTable

fields.name: first sound id of this range
record array in that bank
fields.reason: sound record array named by the bank table

fields.name: ROM bank holding the records and tracks

tables.note: E-0018 (C2: static reading of Func_000_3354, and 495 emulated sound starts read exactly the banks this table names). Func_000_3354 takes the first entry whose first byte is greater than the sound id; the PREVIOUS entry gives the base id, record array and bank. A first byte of $FF ends the table.
